dialog.english:
It's the network Etemon uses to
find our location.
dialog.translation:
Es la red que usa Etemon para
localizarnos.

dialog.english: What'cha doing?

There! It's Etemon's network data.
I may be able to retrieve
something.
dialog.translation:
Ahí! Son datos de la red de
Etemon. Puede que recupere
algo.

dialog.english: What's this symbol?
An email? Let's open it and see.
"Help me"...?

"If you help me, I'll tell you the
location of the Emblemas."
dialog.translation:
"Si me ayudáis, os diré dónde
están los Emblemas."

dialog.english: The Emblemas!
What's he trying to say?

Anyway, should we go to the
e-mail's source?
dialog.translation:
Bueno, vamos al origen
del email?

dialog.english:
Yeah, let's make sure he's got his
money where his mouth is.
dialog.translation:
Sí, a ver si es de fiar
lo que dice.

dialog.english: They should be around here, but...

Okay, let's split up and look for
them!
Hey, Tai.

If I find my Crest, will Tokomon
be able to evolve again?
dialog.translation:
Si hallo mi Emblema, podrá
Tokomon evolucionar de nuevo?

dialog.english: We don't know yet.
I'm sure he will!

Yeah. I guess we'll have to find
out once we get the Emblemas.
dialog.translation:
Sí. Supongo que lo sabremos
cuando tengamos los Emblemas.

dialog.english: Yeah.
Yeah...!

Yup! He was able to evolve before,
he'll do it again!
dialog.translation:
Claro! Ya evolucionó antes,
lo hará otra vez!

dialog.english: Yeah!
This place is weird!
This wall...could it be...
It's glowing!
It's my Crest...!
We did it, T.K!

Doesn't seem like it was a trap,
then.
The rest of the email's arrived!

It says..."I'll tell you where the
last one is, after you help me."
dialog.translation:
Dice... "Os diré dónde está
el último, si me ayudáis."

dialog.english:
It seems that there's one Crest
left!

Okay, let's go help 'em right
away!
Hey, look over there!

That's undoubtedly the same
characters as in Andromon's 
factory...
dialog.translation:
Sin duda son los mismos
caracteres que en la fábrica
de Andromon...

dialog.english: ...and Centarumon's ruins.

Ah, you mean the ones from back
then!
dialog.translation:
Ah, te refieres a esos
de antes!

dialog.english:
In this world, the writing on the
walls provides energy.
dialog.translation:
En este mundo, lo escrito en
los muros da energía.

dialog.english:
You can do that just by writing on
the wall? It's not like we're in a
computer...
dialog.translation:
Y eso se hace solo escribiendo
en el muro? No estamos en
un ordenador...

dialog.english: How do we know we're not?

This is a world where programs and
data materialize in solid form.
dialog.translation:
Es un mundo donde programas
y datos toman forma sólida.

dialog.english:
At least, that is what I have been
thinking.
dialog.translation:
Al menos, eso es lo que
pienso.

dialog.english:
Come to think of it, you said
something like that before.
dialog.translation:
Ahora que lo dices, algo así
dijiste antes.

dialog.english:
If this world is made of data,
does that mean we are, too?
dialog.translation:
Si este mundo es de datos,
nosotros también lo somos?

dialog.english:
Yes. It means we're currently made
of insubstantial data.
dialog.translation:
Sí. Ahora mismo somos datos
sin sustancia física.

dialog.english:
So you mean we're not here in the
flesh?
dialog.translation:
O sea que no estamos en
carne y hueso?

dialog.english: Are we like ghosts or something?
Perhaps something like that.

But then, where are our real
bodies?
Probably...still back at camp?

So it's like we're in the middle
of a game?
dialog.translation:
Entonces es como si
estamos en un juego?

dialog.english: It's not as simple as that...ah!
What's up?
Wait a minute!

If I match the program I got from
Andromon's town and Gennai's
map...
dialog.translation:
Si combino el programa de
Andromon con el mapa de
Gennai...

dialog.english:
I might be able to make a map of
this world!
dialog.translation:
Podría hacer un mapa de
este mundo!

dialog.english:
It's big...it's about the same
size as Earth...
dialog.translation:
Es enorme... del mismo
tamaño que la Tierra...

dialog.english: In fact, it's exactly the same!
What?!

The shapes of this world's network
and our world's is exactly the
same.
dialog.translation:
La red de este mundo y la
del nuestro tienen la misma
forma.

dialog.english:
In other words, this Digital World
is like Earth's shadow!
dialog.translation:
O sea que el Digimundo es
como la sombra de la Tierra!

dialog.english: The Earth's...

...shadow? So we were on Earth the
whole time?
dialog.translation:
...la sombra? Siempre
estuvimos en la Tierra?

dialog.english:
Does that mean we can go home
soon?

No. We're very close, but we're
not on the Earth itself...
dialog.translation:
No. Estamos muy cerca, pero
no en la Tierra misma...

dialog.english:
With every passing minute I get
more confused on what to do...
dialog.translation:
Cada minuto que pasa me lío
más con qué hacer...

dialog.english:
Anyway, Izzy, what should we
do if we want to help the email's
sender?
dialog.translation:
Bueno, Izzy, qué hacemos
para ayudar a quien mandó
el email?

dialog.english:
I'll run the program that came in
the email. If I do that, then...
dialog.translation:
Voy a ejecutar el programa
del email. Si lo hago...

dialog.english: Ah, the back wall...
I can see the outside!

It seems that the program connects
spaces.
dialog.translation:
Parece que el programa
conecta espacios.

dialog.english: All right, let's go!

The one who sent the email is over
there.
dialog.translation:
Quien mandó el email está
ahí.

dialog.english: Ah! That's...

What happened, huh? The Chosen
Children escaped!
dialog.translation:
Qué pasó? Los Niños
Elegidos escaparon!

dialog.english:
Yeah, but all we have to do is fix
the problems in this pyramid's
host computer...
dialog.translation:
Sí, pero solo hay que arreglar
los fallos del ordenador
de la pirámide...

dialog.english:
Nanomon...I'll make you pay for
this!

Tomorrow, we'll finally get to
explore the pyramid! For now, it's
time for bed.
dialog.translation:
Mañana por fin exploraremos
la pirámide! Por ahora, a
dormir.

dialog.english: Goodnight, Tai!

There's a hidden passageway in the
pyramid. It's usually invisible.
dialog.translation:
Hay un pasadizo oculto en la
pirámide. Normalmente es
invisible.

dialog.english:
So our goal is to save this
person, so we can get Sora's
Crest.
dialog.translation:
Debemos salvarlo para
conseguir el Emblema de Sora.

dialog.english: Yep, yep!

This means we absolutely can't get
into any unnecessary fighting!
dialog.translation:
Eso significa que no podemos
meternos en peleas
innecesarias!

dialog.english: I know, I know! Okay, let's go!

The hidden passage should be
around here.
dialog.translation:
El pasadizo oculto debe
estar por aquí.

dialog.english: It's here!

Is it possible to get through
here?

There's only data for projected
appearance, there's nothing in it.
dialog.translation:
Solo hay datos de
apariencia proyectada, no
hay nada dentro.

dialog.english: Huh...
Be careful, everyone!
It's a dead end!

It's like the hidden passage in 
the entrance. If we hit the switch
we should be able to go through.
dialog.translation:
Es el pasadizo de la entrada.
Si activamos el interruptor,
deberíamos poder pasar.

dialog.english: Okay!

The wall data structure has
changed somewhere, so it seems
that we can pass through!
dialog.translation:
La estructura de datos del
muro cambió en algún punto,
parece que podemos pasar!

dialog.english: Okay, let's head over there.

Here? Ain't there a high-voltage
current here?
dialog.translation:
Aquí? No hay corriente de
alto voltaje?

dialog.english:
Yes, but part of this wall is made
up of only surface appearance
data.
dialog.translation:
Sí, pero parte de este muro
solo es apariencia
superficial.

dialog.english:
That means the rest of it is
electric current...
dialog.translation:
Entonces el resto es
corriente eléctrica...

dialog.english: You're chickening out, Joe.
Of course I am!

You're too timid, Joe. We're just
data, after all.
dialog.translation:
Eres un miedica, Joe. Total,
solo somos datos.

dialog.english: Tai..

Sora, quiet down! We'll get
caught!
dialog.translation:
Sora, baja la voz! Nos
pillarán!

dialog.english: So, where's the entrance?
Ah, it's here.
Huh. Okay, let's go!
Here's the destination.
This is...

Thank you for coming, Chosen
Children.

Is this the Digimon who sent the
email?
dialog.translation:
Es este el Digimon que
mandó el email?

dialog.english:
Correct. I once fought with
Etemon...and was defeated.
dialog.translation:
Correcto. Luché contra
Etemon una vez... y perdí.

dialog.english: You fought Etemon?

After losing, I was made into the
host of Etemon's network here.
dialog.translation:
Tras perder, me hicieron
anfitrión de la red de
Etemon.

dialog.english:
I recovered, and without Etemon
noticing, became able to interfere
in external affairs.
dialog.translation:
Me recuperé y, sin que Etemon
se diera cuenta, pude interferir
en asuntos externos.

dialog.english:
But I need your help in order to
release my seal.
dialog.translation:
Necesito ayuda para
liberar mi sello.

dialog.english:
What about my Crest? You know
where it is, right?
dialog.translation:
Y mi Emblema? Sabes dónde
está, verdad?

dialog.english:
Of course. I know many things that
even Etemon does not.
dialog.translation:
Por supuesto. Sé muchas cosas
que ni Etemon sabe.

dialog.english: Got it! So, what should we do?

I want you to pull the lever and
release my seal.
dialog.translation:
Tirad de la palanca y
liberad mi sello.

dialog.english: Izzy! Help me out here.
Yes!
All right, here we go! One, two...
We did it!
Heh heh heh...

Your role is finished! I don't
need you anymore!
dialog.translation:
Tu papel ha terminado! Ya no
te necesito!

dialog.english: What?!
What are you doing?!
Sora! Piyomon!

I'll be able to use their power to
its full potential!
dialog.translation:
Podré usar su poder al
máximo potencial!

dialog.english: Soraaaaaaaaa!!
Taiiiiiiiiiiiiiiii!!

They fled into a hidden
passageway!
Hurry, we've got to chase them!

Tai, please wait! If we don't
check carefully for the false
wall...
dialog.translation:
Tai, espera, por favor! Si no
revisamos bien el muro
falso...

dialog.english:
We're data, aren't we? If we fail,
we can just keep trying again and
again!
dialog.translation:
Somos datos, no? Si
fallamos, podemos
intentarlo una y otra vez!

dialog.english:
Tai, you're not thinking that
this is a game just because we're
data, are you?
dialog.translation:
Tai, no estarás pensando que
esto es un juego solo porque
somos datos, verdad?

dialog.english: Huh? It's not?

It's the same as living on Earth
here! If you die here, you'll
actually die!
dialog.translation:
Aquí es como vivir en la
Tierra! Si mueres aquí,
morirás de verdad!

dialog.english:
What...? N-no way. I didn't think
I could really die...
dialog.translation:
Qué? No puede ser. No
creía que pudiera morir...

dialog.english: Tai...

The hidden passageway is one meter
to your right.
dialog.translation:
El pasadizo oculto está a
un metro a tu derecha.

dialog.english: Tai...

(W-what am I doing...Sora's in
danger...)
There you are!
Etemon!

Mghiiiiii! How dare you release
Nanomon, you villains!
dialog.translation:
Mghiiiiii! Cómo os atrevéis
a liberar a Nanomon!

dialog.english: We can't win in this state!

Let's run for it! We'll use the
hidden passageway!
Tai! This way, quickly!
Khikiiiiiiii!! Wait!
Everyoooooone!
Izzy...

I've got it! Nanomon only
pretended to run away!
dialog.translation:
Ya lo tengo! Nanomon solo
fingió que huía!

dialog.english: What? No way!

You mean they're still in the
pyramid?
dialog.translation:
O sea que siguen en
la pirámide?

dialog.english:
Yes! There is a hidden room even
deeper in the pyramid, below the
basement!
dialog.translation:
Sí! Hay una sala oculta aún
más profunda, bajo el
sótano!

dialog.english: Nanomon and Sora must be there!
dialog.translation:
Nanomon y Sora deben
estar ahí!

dialog.english:
Sora's there...I know I'll be
putting everyone else in danger.
dialog.translation:
Sora está allí... sé que
pondré a todos en peligro.

dialog.english:
But I want to do anything I can to
save Sora! So...
dialog.translation:
Pero quiero hacer lo que
sea para salvarla!

dialog.english: We understand, Tai.
We feel the same as you do!
Sora's a friend to all of us!
Let's go save her together!
Guys...
So, I'll explain the strategy.
I'll be the scout!

The biggest issue is Etemon. If we
don't run into him, we have a high
chance of rescuing her.
dialog.translation:
El problema es Etemon. Si no
nos encontramos con él,
podemos rescatarla.

dialog.english: So what should we do?

We'll split into groups. One will
enter from the front, while the 
other enters the hidden passage.
dialog.translation:
Nos dividiremos en grupos.
Uno entrará por delante y
el otro por el pasadizo.

dialog.english:
If one group encounters Etemon,
the other can still rescue her.
dialog.translation:
Si un grupo se topa con
Etemon, el otro podrá
rescatarla igual.

dialog.english: I see...

One group will contain Tai,
Joe, and myself. The other will
have Matt, T.K, and Mimi.
dialog.translation:
Un grupo será Tai, Joe y yo.
El otro será Matt, T.K. y
Mimi.

dialog.english:
That's how I've divided it.
Tai, which way do you want to
enter?
dialog.translation:
Así los he dividido. Tai,
por dónde quieres entrar?

dialog.english: Izzy, Joe and I to the passage!
dialog.translation:
Izzy, Joe y yo por el
pasadizo!

dialog.english: Izzy, Joe and I to the front!
dialog.translation: Izzy, Joe y yo por delante!

dialog.english: So it's decided, then.

Please avoid any unnecessary
battles. If you encounter
Etemon...
dialog.translation:
Evitad peleas innecesarias.
Si os encontráis con
Etemon...

dialog.english:
Buy as much time as you can, then
find a chance to run away.
dialog.translation:
Ganad todo el tiempo
posible y buscad la
ocasión de huir.

dialog.english:
Okay! Leave it to me. Tai,
we're counting on you, too!
dialog.translation:
Vale! Déjamelo a mí. Tai,
contamos contigo también!

dialog.english: Got it!

Let's all make it back here in one
piece!
dialog.translation:
Volvamos todos aquí de
una pieza!

dialog.english: Piyomon! I-I can't move...

You shouldn't overexert yourself.
Piyomon is merely unconscious.
dialog.translation:
No deberías esforzarte tanto.
Piyomon solo está
inconsciente.

dialog.english:
I have a duty to defeat Etemon,
you see.
dialog.translation:
Debo vencer a Etemon,
ya ves.

dialog.english:
Then you're out of luck! Piyomon
can't evolve without me!
dialog.translation:
Pues mala suerte! Piyomon
no puede evolucionar sin mí!

dialog.english: You are not necessary.

You children have yet to draw out
the power of the Emblemas, so I'll 
make a copy of you.
dialog.translation:
Vosotros aún no habéis
sacado el poder de los Emblemas,
haré una copia tuya.

dialog.english: What?!

With your copy, I'll use the
Crest's power.
dialog.translation:
Con tu copia, usaré el
poder del Emblema.

dialog.english:
My Crest! So *you* had it all
along!

When I fought with Etemon, I lost
most of my memories...
dialog.translation:
Al luchar contra Etemon,
perdí todos mis
recuerdos...

dialog.english:
I'll do anything just to get my
revenge on Etemon, no matter what
it takes!
dialog.translation:
Haré lo que sea para
vengarme de Etemon, cueste
lo que cueste!

dialog.english:
So we're going in through the
front.
The hidden passage is this way.
dialog.translation:
El pasadizo oculto es por
aquí.

dialog.english: Okay, guys! Be careful!

Okay! Let's enter the pyramid
while we can!
dialog.translation:
Vale! Entremos en la
pirámide ya!

dialog.english: Come on, everyone, let's hurry!
Ah! There are Gazimon here!

Doesn't look like they've noticed
us over here yet.
dialog.translation:
No parece que nos hayan
visto todavía.

dialog.english:
Okay, let's keep going, so they
won't notice us...
dialog.translation:
Vale, sigamos, para que no
nos vean...

dialog.english: Okay!
Etemon!

You children! Why are you here?
Oh, right, you're here to figure
out Nanomon's whereabouts, right?
dialog.translation:
Niños! Qué hacéis aquí? Ah,
claro, venís a averiguar
dónde está Nanomon, no?

dialog.english:
Too bad, I can't tell you! Khiki!
We're in the middle of a search
for him even as we speak!
dialog.translation:
Qué pena, no os lo puedo
decir! Khiki! Ahora mismo
lo estamos buscando!

dialog.english:
Looks like they haven't found
Nanomon...
dialog.translation:
Parece que no han
hallado a Nanomon...

dialog.english: Yeah.

Etemon! Nanomon will probably
return Sora if we defeat you! So
I'll challenge you!
dialog.translation:
Etemon! Si te derrotamos,
seguro que nos devuelve a
Sora! Te reto!

dialog.english:
Ughikiki! Interesting! In that
case, I'll play along with you!
dialog.translation:
Ughikiki! Interesante! En
ese caso, os sigo el juego!

dialog.english:
Ukiiii! You challenged me, but
you're not giving it any effort!
dialog.translation:
Ukiiii! Me retáis, pero no
ponéis ningún esfuerzo!

dialog.english:
We were just trying to buy time,
you know!
Yup!

The other brats aren't here. You
guys must be plotting something.
dialog.translation:
Los otros mocosos no están
aquí. Seguro que tramáis
algo.

dialog.english:
We're not hiding anything! There's
no hidden underground room and
nobody in there!
dialog.translation:
No escondemos nada! No hay
ninguna sala subterránea
oculta ni nadie ahí!

dialog.english: Aaaaahhh...!
Aaaah! I'm sorry!

Mkiiiii!! I didn't know there was
such a thing in here! Wait for me,
Nanomon!
dialog.translation:
Mkiiiii!! No sabía que
había algo así aquí!
Espérame, Nanomon!

dialog.english: This is bad! We have to chase him!

Are Matt and the others gonna be
okay?
dialog.translation:
Estarán bien Matt y los
demás?

dialog.english:
Don't worry about them. Come on,
let's hurry!
dialog.translation:
No te preocupes por ellos.
Vamos, deprisa!

dialog.english: Sora's on the other side!
I'll go first, Tai!
Wait, Agumon!
Tai...

I'll go! There's something very
important on the other side of
this wall!
dialog.translation:
Voy yo! Hay algo muy
importante al otro lado
de este muro!

dialog.english: ...Sora?

Yeah! But not just her! There's
something else very important that
I lost back then!
dialog.translation:
Sí! Pero no solo ella! Hay
otra cosa muy importante
que perdí entonces!

dialog.english: Tai...
Whoaaaaaaaa!
We did it!
We did it!

You did it, Tai! Okay, let's go
find Sora!
dialog.translation:
Lo lograste, Tai! Vale
vamos a buscar a Sora!

dialog.english: Yeah!
Sora!! Nanomon, give Sora back!
Tai! That's a fake!
Huh?!
He's making a copy of Sora!
Tai!
Sora!
The copy has just been completed.
dialog.translation:
La copia se acaba de
completar.

dialog.english:
If I give this copy the real one's
holy device and Crest...
dialog.translation:
Si a esta copia le doy el
dispositivo y Emblema
reales...

dialog.english: ...this one will become real!
I won't let you do that!

We did it! We got back the Crest
and Digivice!
dialog.translation:
Recuperamos el Emblema
y el Digivice!

dialog.english: Sora, you're okay!

Thank you, Tai! Thank you,
everyone!
Are you okay, Piyomon?
Yeah! Soraaaaa!
Piyomon!
N-no way...
Mkiiii!! You're too slow!

Tai! Looks like you pulled it
off!

Matt! Yeah, it was all thanks to
your help!
dialog.translation:
Matt! Sí, fue gracias a
vuestra ayuda!

dialog.english:
I will not allow anyone to
interfere with my revenge on
Etemon!
dialog.translation:
No dejaré que nadie
interfiera en mi venganza
contra Etemon!

dialog.english:
I'll make you disappear into the
powers of darkness!
dialog.translation:
Os haré desaparecer en
los poderes de la
oscuridad!

dialog.english: Khikiiii!
What's that?!
Kyaaaaaaaaaaaah!
Sora! Take the Crest and Digivice!
dialog.translation:
Sora! Toma el Emblema y
Digivice!

dialog.english: Piyomon! Protect them!
Okay! Leave it to me!

All right, let's get out of here!
Guys!

Mkiiii! The children may have
gotten away, but this is the end
for you!
dialog.translation:
Mkiiii! Los niños habrán
escapado, pero esto se
acaba aquí!

dialog.english:
I'm taking you down with me,
Etemon!

L-Let me go! I refuse to die here
with you! Kyaaaaaaaaaah!
dialog.translation:
S-suéltame! Me niego a
morir aquí contigo!
Kyaaaaaaaaaah!

dialog.english:
Okay, we're going in through the
front.

And we'll take the hidden
passageway.
dialog.translation:
Y nosotros por el
pasadizo oculto.

dialog.english:
All right, let's head into the
pyramid!
Yeah! I'll do my best, too!

Ugh. The Gazimon are keeping
watch.

They haven't noticed that we're
here yet.

They don't seem to be that
vigilant, then.

Yeah, so let's be as cautious as
possible.
dialog.translation:
Sí, así que vayamos con
mucho cuidado.

dialog.english: Hey, hey, Etemon!

You children! Why are you here?
Oh, right, you're here to figure
out Nanomon's whereabouts, right?
dialog.translation:
Niños! Qué hacéis aquí? Ah,
claro, venís a averiguar
dónde está Nanomon, no?

dialog.english:
Too bad, I can't tell you! Khiki!
We're in the middle of a search
for him even as we speak!
dialog.translation:
Qué pena, no os lo puedo
decir! Khiki! Ahora mismo
lo estamos buscando!

dialog.english:
He most definitely has not figured
out where Nanomon is yet.
dialog.translation:
Seguro que no ha averiguado
dónde está Nanomon.

dialog.english: Well, he'd fooled us, too.

Etemon! If we defeat you, we'll
get Sora back! Get ready!
dialog.translation:
Etemon! Si te derrotamos,
recuperamos a Sora!
Prepárate!

dialog.english:
Ughikiki! Interesting! I'll play
along with you, then!
dialog.translation:
Ughikiki! Interesante! En
ese caso, os sigo el juego!

dialog.english:
Ukiiii! You challenged me, but
you're not giving it any effort!
dialog.translation:
Ukiiii! Me retáis, pero no
ponéis ningún esfuerzo!

dialog.english: He's strong...

Sora's life depends on this, hang
in there!
dialog.translation:
La vida de Sora depende
de esto, aguanta!

dialog.english:
The other brats aren't here...are
you guys plotting something?
Khikii!
dialog.translation:
Los otros mocosos no
están... tramáis algo?
Khikii!

dialog.english:
Don't be silly! We're going down
to a hidden room underneath the
basement to fight Nanomon!
dialog.translation:
No seas tonto! Vamos a la
sala oculta bajo el sótano
a luchar contra Nanomon!

dialog.english: Joe...
...you idiot!
Aaaah! I messed up...

Mkiiiii!! I didn't know there was
such a thing in here! Wait for me,
Nanomon!
dialog.translation:
Mkiiiii!! No sabía que
había algo así aquí!
Espérame, Nanomon!

dialog.english: We have to chase Etemon!
We got in, surprisingly easily.

Yeah, let's hurry before they
notice us!
dialog.translation:
Sí, démonos prisa antes
de que nos vean!

dialog.english: We're back here, huh?
Are you gonna be okay, Matt?

I know where the fake part of the
wall is.
dialog.translation:
Sé dónde está la parte
falsa del muro.

dialog.english: Yeah...

I'll go in first! Once I do, all
of you come in after me!
dialog.translation:
Entro yo primero! En
cuanto lo haga, venid
todos detrás!

dialog.english: We did it!
*pant*...Thank goodness, Matt!
We did it!!
Okay, guys, be careful!
There they are!
Sora!
No! That's a fake!
What?!
He's making a copy of Sora!
Matt! Guys!
Sora!
The copy has just been completed.
dialog.translation:
La copia se acaba de
completar.

dialog.english:
If I give this copy the real one's
holy device and Crest...
dialog.translation:
Si a esta copia le doy el
dispositivo y Emblema
reales...

dialog.english: ...this one will become real!
We won't let you do that!

Good job, guys! We got the Crest
and the Digivice back!
dialog.translation:
Buen trabajo! Recuperamos
el Emblema y el Digivice!

dialog.english: Soraaaaaaaaaa! Thank goodness!
Thank you, everyone!
Are you okay, Piyomon?
Thanks, T.K! Soraaaaaa!
Piyomon...
N-no way...
Mkiiii!! You're too slow!
Matt! Thank goodness, Sora!

Tai! It's thanks to everyone
else that we could do it!
dialog.translation:
Tai! Fue gracias a todos
que lo conseguimos!

dialog.english:
I will not allow anyone to
interfere with my revenge on
Etemon!
dialog.translation:
No dejaré que nadie
interfiera en mi venganza
contra Etemon!

dialog.english:
I'll make you disappear into the
powers of darkness!
dialog.translation:
Os haré desaparecer en
los poderes de la
oscuridad!

dialog.english: Khikiiii!
What's that?!
Kyaaaaaaaaaaaah!
Sora! Take the Crest and Digivice!
dialog.translation:
Sora! Toma el Emblema y
Digivice!

dialog.english: Piyomon! Protect them!
Okay! Leave it to me!

All right, let's get out of here!
Guys!

Mkiiii! The children may have
gotten away, but this is the end
for you!
dialog.translation:
Mkiiii! Los niños habrán
escapado, pero esto se
acaba aquí!

dialog.english:
I'm taking you down with me,
Etemon!

L-Let me go! I refuse to die here
with you! Kyaaaaaaaaaah!
dialog.translation:
S-suéltame! Me niego a
morir aquí contigo!
Kyaaaaaaaaaah!

dialog.english: Look! The pyramid!
Aaaaah!
What happened?

Nanomon kicked the bucket on his
own. Now it's your turn! Ukikiiii!
dialog.translation:
Nanomon la palmó él
solito. Ahora te toca a
ti! Ukikiiii!

dialog.english:
At this rate, we won't be able to
run away.
dialog.translation:
A este paso, no podremos
huir.

dialog.english: The whole world's going crazy!

No, there's only one thing left to
do!
dialog.translation:
No, solo queda una cosa
por hacer!

dialog.english: Look! Tai's Crest...

It's glowing. The Crest is
glowing!

I swear I won't run away! I won't
give up until the very end!
Greymon!
dialog.translation:
Juro que no huiré! No me
rendiré hasta el final!
Greymon!

dialog.english:
Tai's courage...it's swelling
up within my body!
dialog.translation:
El valor de Tai...crece
dentro de mi cuerpo!

dialog.english: Whoaaaa!
Amazing, amazing!
This is...
...the Crest's power!

This...this is Greymon's true
evolution!
dialog.translation:
Es la verdadera evolución
de Greymon!

dialog.english:
You can't beat me just because you
evolved a *tiny* bit further!
dialog.translation:
No me venceréis solo por
evolucionar un poco más!

dialog.english:
I-I don't want to disappear. I'm a
huge star! I can't die like
this...
dialog.translation:
N-no quiero desaparecer.
Soy una gran estrella! No
puedo morir así...

dialog.english: Whoa!
Tai!
MetalGreymon!
Tai!
Taiiiiiiiii!
Taiiiiiiiii!
We're...

Let's get some rest tonight, so we
can prepare for tomorrow.
dialog.translation:
Descansemos esta noche
para prepararnos para
mañana.

dialog.english:
Wait, Tai. We're sneaking in
from the back, aren't we?
dialog.translation:
Espera, Tai. Vamos a
colarnos por detrás, no?

dialog.english: Oh, right.

I'll operate the panel over here,
so I'll leave the lever over there
to you, Tai.
dialog.translation:
Yo manejo el panel de
aquí, la palanca de allí
te la dejo a ti, Tai.

dialog.english: Okay, got it!

Tai, where are you going? We
have to help Nanomon!
dialog.translation:
Tai, a dónde vas? Tenemos
que ayudar a Nanomon!

dialog.english: Sora...
Turn in for the night
Talk with everyone for a bit longer
dialog.translation:
Hablar un rato más con
todos

dialog.english: I'm not in the mood to chat
Chat with everyone

Can we really trust whoever sent
that email?
dialog.translation:
Podemos fiarnos de quien
mandó ese email?

dialog.english:
I don't know, but I'd like to have
even a little info about the
Emblemas.
dialog.translation:
No lo sé, pero me gustaría
saber algo de los
Emblemas.

dialog.english:
Yeah, we've got to do what we can
before Etemon can corner us.
dialog.translation:
Sí, hay que hacer lo
posible antes de que
Etemon nos acorrale.

dialog.english:
It'll be fine! We'll figure
something out soon!
dialog.translation:
Todo irá bien! Se nos
ocurrirá algo pronto!

dialog.english:
I'm sorry, Tai. You're doing
all this for my Crest.
dialog.translation:
Lo siento, Tai. Haces
todo esto por mi Emblema.

dialog.english:
Don't worry about it. We're just
data, anyway.
dialog.translation:
No te preocupes. Total,
solo somos datos.

dialog.english:
I've been studying the
relationship between our world and
this world, but still...
dialog.translation:
He estado estudiando la
relación entre nuestro
mundo y este, pero...

dialog.english: Don't push yourself too hard!
Figure it out as fast as you can!

Oh no, I'm not pushing myself,
but...thank you very much.
dialog.translation:
No, no me esfuerzo
demasiado, pero...
muchas gracias.

dialog.english:
I'm doing the best I can. There's
a limit to my abilities, so please
understand.
dialog.translation:
Hago lo que puedo. Mis
habilidades tienen un
límite, entendedlo.

dialog.english: Yeah, I know.

Izzy, don't be pushin'
yourself too far...

I'm glad you got your Crest,
T.K!
dialog.translation:
Me alegro de tu
Emblema, T.K.!

dialog.english:
Yeah!
Now I'll be able to evolve Tokomon
into Patamon again!
dialog.translation:
Sí! Ahora podré volver a
evolucionar a Tokomon en
Patamon!

dialog.english: I'm looking forward to that!
Isn't it great, T.K?
Yeah!
If I'd saved Sora back then...

Don't just go around blaming
yourself, Tai. Think about what
you can do right now.
dialog.translation:
No te culpes sin más,
Tai. Piensa en lo que
puedes hacer ahora.

dialog.english:
It's frustrating, I feel the same
way...
Sora will be fine, right?

Yeah, Sora's strong, so she'll be
fine!
dialog.translation:
Sí, Sora es fuerte,
estará bien!

dialog.english: Yeah! I'll believe in her!

It'll be fine. Cheer up, Mimi! You
too, Tai!
dialog.translation:
Todo irá bien. Ánimo,
Mimi! Y tú también, Tai!

dialog.english: Yeah. Thanks, Palmon.

Tai, this isn't the time for
you to be feeling down.
dialog.translation:
Tai, no es momento de
venirse abajo.

dialog.english: I don't want to talk about it.
If I just had some courage there...

Get yourself together! Feeling bad
isn't going to bring Sora back!
dialog.translation:
Recomponte! Sentirte mal
no va a traer de vuelta
a Sora!

dialog.english: I don't want to hear that...
Gh...Tai...

Wouldn't it be great if we could
take back our mistakes? Look
at me, I'm full of mistakes.
dialog.translation:
No sería genial poder
deshacer nuestros errores?
Mírame, estoy lleno de errores.

dialog.english:
You're doing comparatively well,
Tai.
dialog.translation:
Lo estás haciendo
bastante bien, Tai.

dialog.english: Joe...Thank you!
Cheer up, Tai!
Yeah. Thanks, Gomamon.

I hear the sound of something
moving upstairs.

I hear the sound of something
moving downstairs.
It's a pit!

We're charging in through the
front!

We're charging in through the
front!
This isn't the time to turn back!
dialog.translation:
No es momento de
echarse atrás!

dialog.english: This isn't the time to turn back!
dialog.translation:
No es momento de
echarse atrás!
